families.name: Starry Initials
families.description: Every capital is a gold letter in a square of turning sky, with rings of light around it and stars in the corners. The rest of the text is painted in the blues of the sky.
families.sample: The Night Is Full Of Stars

families.name: Starry
families.description: The same letters without the sky: currents of blue paint that follow each stroke, with sparks of yellow down the middle.
families.sample: The Night Is Full Of Stars
